metadata.selection: only bins with at least one dive deeper than the chart beyond the location uncertainty

properties.d: dives deeper than the deepest GEBCO_2026 15" cell within 1 x location s.e. by > 20 m
properties.dp: dives deeper than GEBCO_2026 at the dive location (bilinear) by > 20 m
properties.x: largest excess in the bin (m) = max_dep minus the deepest chart depth within the uncertainty
properties.cd: mean GEBCO_2026 depth at the dive locations (m, positive down; negative = chart says land/ice)
